findings.name: Hardcoded Secrets
findings.risk_summary: Hardcoded secret key enables unauthorized access.
findings.description: The secret key is hardcoded in the authConfig.js file.
findings.mitigation: Load secret from environment variable instead of hardcoding.
findings.fixed_code: const secretKey = process.env.SECRET_KEY; // Fixed: use env var

findings.name: Weak Password Handling
findings.risk_summary: Hardcoded user passwords enable unauthorized access.
findings.description: The user passwords are hardcoded in the authConfig.js file.
findings.mitigation: Load passwords from a secure storage and hash them before comparison. Use a secure method like bcrypt to hash and verify passwords.

findings.name: Weak Password Handling
findings.description: The passwords are stored in plaintext in the users array.
findings.mitigation: Hash password with bcrypt before storage and compare hashed password with hashed input.
